She begins a dance routine with fluid arm waves and side-to-side stepping. The setting features a red brick wall on the right and a dark, textured wall on the left, illuminated by natural overhead daylight. No text is visible. (2) The dancer performs more energetic movements, including a full spin that makes her skirt flare out significantly. She maintains a cheerful expression with her mouth open in a smile while executing precise hand gestures and jumping steps on the tiled ground. The camera captures her in a medium shot with slight handheld vibration. (3) Approaching the camera, she performs a series of playful facial expressions and hand signs, moving closer to the lens for a medium close-up effect. The architectural lines of the alley provide a strong sense of depth behind her. She finishes the sequence with a confident pose, smiling directly at the viewer.
